title: notification.campaign.send_due
description: Internal to notification. A scheduled campaign send (`POST /engage/campaigns/{id}/schedule`) is due. Staged by `notification.services.schedule_send` as the target of a `platform.schedule.requested` (ADR-0015); the scheduler republishes it unchanged at `due_at`, and `notification.consumers.expand_campaign_send` handles it exactly like `engage.campaign.campaign.send_requested`. `notification.` because the scheduler only delivers events namespaced under the requesting service. `scheduled_for` — the instant the request was made for — is what lets the handler drop a firing a reschedule or a cancel has since superseded.

scheduled_for.description: The `scheduled_at` this firing was requested for, compared with the campaign's current `scheduled_at` before it is activated.
